name: Okaeri, Boku no Suki na Hito
original_name: おかえり、僕の好きな人
source:
You live alone in your late grandmother's seaside house in Gokurakuji. A childhood love of the cute animal figures and playhouses called Coastal Critters led you to work at a toy company after college. Your dream is to some day work on the Coastal Critters team, but right now you're in the capsule toy division. Mr. Kato, your manager, overworks you, sends you on ridiculous errands, and constantly turns down your project ideas.

You come home every night to an empty house, exhausted. All you want is for someone to recognize your hard work and be there for you. If only you had someone to come home to, someone you could vent to who would listen to all your troubles and make you feel better.

And one day, a handsome man magically shows up on your doorstep and works his way both into your home and your heart...

[from [url=http://voltage-inc.wikia.com/wiki/Love_Brings_You_Home]Voltage Wiki[/url]]
translation:
你独自住在已故祖母位于极乐寺的海滨别墅里。童年时期对可爱的动物人物和名为Coastal Critters的剧场的喜爱促使你在大学毕业后在一家玩具公司工作。你的梦想是有一天在Coastal Critters团队工作，但现在你在胶囊玩具部门工作。你的经理加藤先生让你过度劳累，派你去做一些荒谬的差事，并不断拒绝你的项目想法。

每天晚上你回到家都是空荡荡的，疲惫不堪。你想要的只是有人认可你的辛勤工作并陪伴你。如果有人可以回家，可以向你发泄，倾听你所有的烦恼，让你感觉好一些就好了。

有一天，一位英俊的男人神奇地出现在你家门口，走进你的家，走进你的心……

[来自[url=http://voltage-inc.wikia.com/wiki/Love_Brings_You_Home]Voltage Wiki[/url]]
